characterList.description: A white male with light brown hair and a beard. He is wearing a camouflage baseball cap, sunglasses, a dark blue t-shirt, and khaki cargo pants.
characterList.name: Rattlehead

content_metadata.description: A metal detecting journey featuring Rattlehead as he uncovers historical artifacts at a site with Civil War history.

qAndA.answer: He is using a Garrett AT Pro.

trimmingSuggestions.description: Scene 4 could be trimmed as it mostly focuses on Rattlehead talking about finding more bottles without actually showing any new finds. This segment slows down the pace and could be shortened to maintain the excitement.
Scene 6 could also be trimmed slightly, focusing more on the ax head itself rather than dwelling on speculation about its age. This would keep the focus on the artifact and its visual appeal.
